target.title: Apps are thin wrappers and preserve bins
target.test: apps/ndx and apps/ndxserver must be thin wrappers over @neurondev/ndx-core while @neurondev/ndx still publishes ndx and ndxserver bins.

steps.instruction: Inspect apps/ndx and apps/ndxserver source files.
steps.expected: App sources only import @neurondev/ndx-core subpaths and invoke exported entrypoints; they do not contain argument parsing, config loading, session orchestration, dashboard rendering, or Docker sandbox logic.

steps.instruction: Build the workspace, then run apps/ndx/dist/bin/ndx.js --version and apps/ndx/dist/bin/ndxserver.js --version.
steps.expected: Both commands print the package version and exit successfully.

steps.instruction: Run yarn workspace @neurondev/ndx npm pack --dry-run and inspect the package files.
steps.expected: The publish package includes compiled bin files for ndx and ndxserver and compiled app files, without source-only dependency on the root src folder.

target.passCriteria: @neurondev/ndx remains install-compatible and apps stay orchestration-only.

target.instruction: Inspect apps/ndx and apps/ndxserver source files.
target.expected: App sources only import @neurondev/ndx-core subpaths and invoke exported entrypoints; they do not contain argument parsing, config loading, session orchestration, dashboard rendering, or Docker sandbox logic.

steps.descript: App sources are bin loaders only.
evidence: apps/ndx/src/bin/ndx.ts imports loadCoreCli and calls main().
apps/ndx/src/bin/ndxserver.ts and apps/ndxserver/src/bin/ndxserver.ts set NDX_INVOKED_AS_SERVER and call core main().
rg over app sources found no config loading, SessionServer construction, dashboard rendering, or Docker sandbox implementation.

target.instruction: Build the workspace, then run apps/ndx/dist/bin/ndx.js --version and apps/ndx/dist/bin/ndxserver.js --version.
target.expected: Both commands print the package version and exit successfully.

steps.descript: Built app bins print the expected version.

target.instruction: Run yarn workspace @neurondev/ndx npm pack --dry-run and inspect the package files.
target.expected: The publish package includes compiled bin files for ndx and ndxserver and compiled app files, without source-only dependency on the root src folder.

steps.descript: The Yarn 4 pack dry-run includes compiled bin files and package docs.
evidence: Dry-run output included dist/bin/ndx.js and dist/bin/ndxserver.js.
Temporary prefix install from /tmp/ndx-core.tgz and /tmp/ndx-app.tgz ran /tmp/ndx-global/bin/ndx --version and /tmp/ndx-global/bin/ndxserver --version, both printing 0.1.35.

result.descript: @neurondev/ndx remains install-compatible and app wrappers stay thin.
evidence: App sources inspected under apps/ndx/src/bin and apps/ndxserver/src/bin.
Commands passed: yarn build; node app bin --version checks; yarn workspace @neurondev/ndx pack --dry-run; npm install -g --prefix /tmp/ndx-global /tmp/ndx-core.tgz /tmp/ndx-app.tgz.
